column1: # Iliad - Part 1.5 — naskah 05 (M23005): rencana Lentine, negosiasi gagal, pidato Vasily.
# Tetap Inggris: Lentine, Kenny, Igla, Omen, Mechty, Andoris, Vector, Zhaohui, Daiyan,
# Faye, Jiangyu, Klukai, Cheyanne, Groza, Wulfgar, Vasily, George, Cecht FABN,
# 'Tomato King', Shell of Amni, Mangi Security, Mokosh, The Elmo, Monsoon Squad,
# Squad 404, Oathguards, Doll, T-Doll, Tactical Doll, Neural cloud, URNC, Yellow Zone.
(Thirty minutes ago, in the Mangi Security command room, Lentine made a preliminary tactical plan based on the Mokosh intelligence currently grasped.)
column2: (Tiga puluh menit lalu, di ruang komando Mangi Security, Lentine menyusun rencana taktis awal berdasarkan informasi Mokosh yang mereka kuasai.)

column1: (Mobilizing massive firepower to attack the enemy's defense systems, destroying Mokosh's military targets as quickly as possible, and forcing the current high command of Mokosh to surrender.)
column2: (Mengerahkan daya tembak masif untuk menggempur sistem pertahanan musuh, menghancurkan sasaran militer Mokosh secepat mungkin, dan memaksa komando tinggi Mokosh saat ini menyerah.)

column1: (Of course, all these plans are based on accurate intelligence. Out of consideration that the 'enemy might already be prepared for defense', the first wave of the assault team is composed of T-Doll squads.)
column2: (Tentu saja, semua rencana ini berpijak pada informasi yang akurat. Dengan pertimbangan bahwa 'musuh mungkin sudah siap bertahan', gelombang pertama pasukan penyerbu terdiri dari regu T-Doll.)

column1: Commander Lentine~ All Tactical Dolls from Mangi Security participating in this mission are ready and can launch the attack at any time.
column2: Komandan Lentine~ Semua Tactical Doll Mangi Security yang ikut misi ini sudah siap dan bisa menyerang kapan saja.

column1: Concentrate all firepower to prioritize destroying Mokosh's anti-air defense system. The first wave of tactical squads will set out immediately after the drones and long-range missiles launch their attacks. You must tear through the enemy's defense network in the shortest possible time.
column2: Pusatkan seluruh daya tembak untuk memprioritaskan penghancuran sistem pertahanan udara Mokosh. Regu taktis gelombang pertama berangkat segera setelah drone dan rudal jarak jauh melancarkan serangan. Kalian harus merobek jaring pertahanan musuh dalam waktu sesingkat mungkin.

column1: After entering the urban area, capture Mokosh's supreme commander alive as quickly as possible to avoid getting drawn into urban warfare that would be disadvantageous to us.
column2: Setelah masuk kawasan kota, tangkap hidup-hidup panglima tertinggi Mokosh secepatnya agar kita tidak terseret ke pertempuran kota yang merugikan.

column1: Understood, the advance squad has been dispatched to the target location.
column2: Dimengerti, regu pendahulu sudah dikirim ke lokasi sasaran.

column1: The system has commenced searching, and I will report back to you the moment the coordinates of the enemy leader are found.
column2: Sistem sudah mulai memindai, dan saya akan langsung melapor begitu koordinat pemimpin musuh ditemukan.

column1: I'll go to the front lines and lead the advance team, Field Commander Lentine.
column2: Saya akan ke garis depan dan memimpin tim pendahulu, Komandan Lapangan Lentine.

column1: No need. It's not your time to lead the team yet.
column2: Tidak perlu. Belum saatnya kau memimpin tim.

column1: Kenny... have you noticed that this city is extremely abnormal.
column2: Kenny... kau sadar tidak kalau kota ini sangat tidak wajar.

column1: ...The residents here seem to have received some training. By the time our people arrived to occupy the outer city, they had already entered the defense facilities under the guidance of those soldiers.
column2: ...Warga di sini sepertinya sudah dilatih. Saat orang-orang kita tiba untuk menduduki kota luar, mereka sudah masuk ke fasilitas pertahanan di bawah arahan para prajurit itu.

column1: That's not what I'm talking about...
column2: Bukan itu maksudku...

column1: The quantity of armaments and personnel we brought this time is clearly unusual, even to an amateur.
column2: Jumlah persenjataan dan personel yang kita bawa kali ini jelas tidak biasa, bahkan bagi orang awam sekalipun.

column1: But most of the residents here haven't fled... even those captured soldiers.
column2: Tapi sebagian besar warga di sini tidak kabur... bahkan para prajurit yang tertangkap itu.

column1: They really believe in that Vasily, and they also really believe in... that person.
column2: Mereka benar-benar percaya pada Vasily itu, dan juga benar-benar percaya pada... orang itu.

column1: Indeed... this is probably why the higher-ups chose to assassinate Vasily directly.
column2: Benar... mungkin itulah kenapa atasan memilih membunuh Vasily secara langsung.

column1: If these people resist to the death, even if we take Mokosh, we will pay a huge price.
column2: Kalau orang-orang ini melawan sampai mati, sekalipun kita merebut Mokosh, harganya akan mahal sekali.

column1: I can already foresee that the first wave of troops attacking Mokosh will face the enemy's maximum intensity counterattack. You and Omen must preserve your combat strength.
column2: Aku sudah bisa memperkirakan gelombang pertama pasukan yang menyerang Mokosh akan menghadapi serangan balik dengan intensitas maksimal. Kau dan Omen harus menjaga kekuatan tempur kalian.

column1: As for the first wave of attacks, let Igla lead the Doll team to coordinate with drones and artillery coverage.
column2: Untuk gelombang serangan pertama, biar Igla yang memimpin tim Doll berkoordinasi dengan drone dan payung artileri.

column1: You... haven't you always distrusted Dolls?
column2: Kau... bukankah kau selalu tidak memercayai Doll?

column1: Not believing and not utilizing are two different things. Dolls are inherently consumables.
column2: Tidak percaya dan tidak memakai itu dua hal berbeda. Doll pada dasarnya barang habis pakai.

column1: This mission is a good opportunity to perform for the higher-ups, but if you want to climb up, staying alive is the most important prerequisite.
column2: Misi ini kesempatan bagus untuk unjuk gigi di depan atasan, tapi kalau mau naik, tetap hidup adalah syarat yang paling utama.

column1: You've always been like this, thinking of everyone.
column2: Kau memang selalu begini, memikirkan semua orang.

column1: I promised you all that I would give everyone who followed me all the way to today a dignified life.
column2: Aku sudah berjanji pada kalian akan memberi hidup yang bermartabat bagi semua orang yang mengikutiku sampai hari ini.

column1: I hope the third-generation Dolls' on-the-spot combat capabilities aren't that bad.
column2: Semoga kemampuan tempur lapangan Doll generasi ketiga tidak seburuk itu.

column1: Igla's Neural cloud wasn't cleared before this mission, so she should... not be like usual, only able to execute the most basic mission commands.
column2: Neural cloud Igla tidak dihapus sebelum misi ini, jadi seharusnya dia... tidak seperti biasanya yang cuma bisa menjalankan perintah misi paling dasar.

column1: Get ready. After breaking through Mokosh's defense line, that's our main battlefield. The mission to capture that person...
column2: Bersiaplah. Setelah garis pertahanan Mokosh tertembus, di situlah medan tempur utama kita. Misi menangkap orang itu...

column1: I will complete it for you.
column2: Akan kutuntaskan untukmu.

column1: He won't be caught that easily. Kenny, never attack rashly, especially you and our people.
column2: Dia tidak akan tertangkap semudah itu. Kenny, jangan sekali-kali menyerang gegabah, terutama kau dan orang-orang kita.

column1: Have our people send me his coordinates and intel immediately if they encounter him.
column2: Kalau orang-orang kita berpapasan dengannya, suruh mereka langsung kirim koordinat dan informasinya padaku.

column1: I will finish them off myself.
column2: Aku sendiri yang akan menghabisinya.

column1: Understood, Field Commander Lentine.
column2: Dimengerti, Komandan Lapangan Lentine.

column1: (As for the Commander Lentine mentioned, Kenny was also very clear about that person's resume. Not to mention that Mangi Security had suffered losses at that person's hands more than once.)
column2: (Soal Komandan yang disebut Lentine, Kenny juga sangat paham rekam jejak orang itu. Belum lagi Mangi Security sudah lebih dari sekali menderita kerugian di tangannya.)

column1: (Therefore, Kenny had no complaints about Lentine's orders, only silently executing them.)
column2: (Karena itu, Kenny tidak protes atas perintah Lentine, hanya menjalankannya diam-diam.)

column1: (Before leaving, Lentine's communication device rang again, and a female voice came from the other end of the communicator.)
column2: (Sebelum pergi, perangkat komunikasi Lentine berdering lagi, dan suara perempuan terdengar dari ujung sana.)

column1: Miss Lentine, I have received the battle report you sent.
column2: Nona Lentine, saya sudah menerima laporan tempur yang Anda kirim.

column1: I seem to understand why Your Excellency, who is highly valued in Mangi Security, has never had a military resume to this day.
column2: Sepertinya saya paham kenapa Anda yang begitu dihargai di Mangi Security sampai hari ini tidak pernah punya rekam jejak militer.

column1: Obviously, everything always has its reasonable points, just like your tactical planning.
column2: Jelas, segala sesuatu selalu ada masuk akalnya, sama seperti perencanaan taktis Anda.

column1: ...If there is anything inappropriate, please point it out, Brigadier General.
column2: ...Kalau ada yang kurang tepat, mohon ditunjukkan, Brigadir Jenderal.

column1: It is an honor to receive your guidance.
column2: Sebuah kehormatan mendapat bimbingan Anda.

column1: Some things can only be understood through personal experience. Make the most of your strengths this time, Miss Lentine.
column2: Ada hal-hal yang hanya bisa dipahami lewat pengalaman sendiri. Manfaatkan kelebihan Anda sebaik-baiknya kali ini, Nona Lentine.

column1: A simple yet executable tactical plan is always better than pompous armchair strategy.
column2: Rencana taktis yang sederhana tapi bisa dijalankan selalu lebih baik daripada strategi di atas kertas yang muluk-muluk.

column1: ...Then, please forgive my bluntness.
column2: ...Kalau begitu, maafkan kelancangan saya.

column1: If possible, I hope the military can also provide some firepower to coordinate the attack on Mokosh.
column2: Kalau memungkinkan, saya berharap militer juga bisa menyumbang daya tembak untuk mendukung serangan ke Mokosh.

column1: According to the battle reports you've given me so far, Mangi Security's armaments and experience far exceed Mokosh's. But you have submitted multiple applications, wanting our cover.
column2: Menurut laporan tempur yang selama ini Anda kirim, persenjataan dan pengalaman Mangi Security jauh melampaui Mokosh. Tapi Anda sudah berkali-kali mengajukan permohonan, meminta perlindungan kami.

column1: It seems you have your own judgment on Mokosh's defense system.
column2: Sepertinya Anda punya penilaian sendiri soal sistem pertahanan Mokosh.

column1: This is just out of respect for the enemy.
column2: Ini semata bentuk rasa hormat pada musuh.

column1: This is your war, I will try my best to cooperate with your actions.
column2: Ini perang Anda, saya akan berusaha sebisanya mendukung tindakan Anda.

column1: I saw that your plan mentioned an enemy that needs special attention.
column2: Saya lihat rencana Anda menyebut satu musuh yang perlu perhatian khusus.

column1: Yes. Judging from the intelligence we've obtained so far, there is a hostile force surrounding the known Mokosh leader.
column2: Ya. Dari informasi yang kami peroleh sejauh ini, ada kekuatan bermusuhan yang mengelilingi pemimpin Mokosh yang kita kenal.

column1: After their surveys, Mangi Security suspects that the person calling themselves the 'Tomato King' is highly likely the armed militant currently wanted by the URNC.
column2: Setelah penyelidikan, Mangi Security menduga orang yang menyebut dirinya 'Tomato King' sangat mungkin adalah militan bersenjata yang kini diburu URNC.

column1: We tracked down several of his strongholds through this clue, perhaps...
column2: Kami melacak beberapa markasnya lewat petunjuk itu, mungkin...

column1: You know him well?
column2: Anda mengenalnya dengan baik?

column1: No, it's just...
column2: Tidak, hanya saja...

column1: Not long ago, the newly appointed manager changed Mokosh's business policy. Not only did they promote so-called "self-management", but they also put forward the illegal slogan of "jointly building the prosperity of the Yellow Zone".
column2: Belum lama ini, manajer baru mengubah kebijakan usaha Mokosh. Mereka bukan hanya menggalakkan apa yang disebut "swakelola", tapi juga mengusung slogan ilegal "membangun kemakmuran Yellow Zone bersama-sama".

column1: I believe that wanted terrorist is highly likely to have manipulated Mokosh's current regime leader, thereby affecting the normal operation of the entire Mokosh.
column2: Saya yakin teroris buronan itu sangat mungkin telah memanipulasi pemimpin rezim Mokosh saat ini, sehingga mengganggu jalannya seluruh Mokosh.

column1: Rather than a large-scale attack to destroy Mokosh, which would require all parties to work together to rebuild the area afterwards.
column2: Alih-alih serangan besar-besaran yang menghancurkan Mokosh, yang setelahnya menuntut semua pihak bekerja sama membangun ulang kawasan itu.

column1: It would be better to act directly from the source, eliminate the leader, replace them with a new person in charge, reduce Mokosh's losses to a controllable range, and also make it more convenient to manage the local residents of Mokosh in the future.
column2: Lebih baik bertindak langsung dari sumbernya, singkirkan pemimpinnya, ganti dengan penanggung jawab baru, tekan kerugian Mokosh ke tingkat yang terkendali, sekaligus mempermudah pengelolaan warga lokal Mokosh ke depannya.

column1: No need to explain too much. I've said it, this is your war.
column2: Tidak perlu banyak menjelaskan. Sudah saya bilang, ini perang Anda.

column1: Just do it according to your plan.
column2: Jalankan saja sesuai rencana Anda.

column1: ...Yes.
column2: ...Baik.

column1: Sir, the first batch of airstrike machines has been cleared.
column2: Pak, gelombang pertama mesin serangan udara sudah dibersihkan.

column1: (In the command center, Vasily and I remotely monitored the battlefield situation outside the city.)
column2: (Di pusat komando, Vasily dan aku memantau situasi medan tempur di luar kota dari jarak jauh.)

column1: (With the cooperation of Monsoon and Squad 404, the drones attacking Mokosh were quickly defeated one after another, but the enemy did not stop their actions, and the second batch of drones quickly filled in.)
column2: (Berkat kerja sama Monsoon dan Squad 404, drone-drone yang menyerang Mokosh cepat dijatuhkan satu per satu, tapi musuh tidak berhenti, dan gelombang kedua drone dengan cepat mengisi celah.)

column1: Ugh, again—Is this some kind of endless breakthrough mode or what?!
column2: Ugh, lagi—Ini mode serbuan tanpa akhir atau apa sih?!

column1: Mechty, make sure not to miss a single enemy drone. Welcome them with everything you've got.
column2: Mechty, jangan sampai ada satu drone musuh pun yang lolos. Sambut mereka dengan semua yang kaupunya.

column1: Got it... But this wave of drones seems a lot smarter. Did the monsters level up?
column2: Siap... Tapi gelombang drone ini kelihatannya jauh lebih pintar. Musuhnya naik Level, ya?

column1: (Mechty increases her firepower under Klukai's urging, but after detecting Mechty's approximate attack range, the drones do not approach directly. Instead, they scatter and hover not far away, then notify the entire battlefield with an extremely loud sound.)
column2: (Mechty menambah daya tembaknya atas desakan Klukai, tapi setelah mendeteksi kira-kira jangkauan serangannya, drone-drone itu tidak mendekat langsung. Mereka justru menyebar dan melayang tak jauh dari sana, lalu menyiarkan ke seluruh medan tempur dengan suara yang sangat keras.)

column1: Warning, all combat personnel in Mokosh, stop resisting immediately and surrender.
column2: Peringatan, seluruh personel tempur di Mokosh, hentikan perlawanan sekarang juga dan menyerah.

column1: Repeating once, warning, all combat personnel in Mokosh, stop resisting immediately and surrender.
column2: Diulangi sekali, peringatan, seluruh personel tempur di Mokosh, hentikan perlawanan sekarang juga dan menyerah.

column1: (Facing the enemy's negotiation, I signaled the squads to temporarily stop their attacks.)
column2: (Menghadapi ajakan bernegosiasi itu, kuberi isyarat pada regu-regu untuk sementara menghentikan serangan.)

column1: (Vasily then connected to the battlefield broadcast, broadcasting the voice belonging to Mokosh to the enemy.)
column2: (Vasily lalu menyambung ke siaran medan tempur, menyiarkan suara milik Mokosh kepada musuh.)

column1: I am the person in charge of Mokosh. Your actions have seriously affected the normal operation of Mokosh!
column2: Saya penanggung jawab Mokosh. Tindakan kalian telah sangat mengganggu jalannya Mokosh!

column1: We have the right to demand your immediate retreat and war reparations.
column2: Kami berhak menuntut kalian mundur segera dan membayar ganti rugi perang.

column1: My demand is very simple: hand over the management authority of Mokosh, and the rest of the negotiation content can continue to advance.
column2: Tuntutan saya sangat sederhana: serahkan wewenang pengelolaan Mokosh, dan sisa isi negosiasi bisa dilanjutkan.

column1: Heh, a stranger who knows nothing about Mokosh wants to become the ruler of Mokosh right off the bat?
column2: Heh, orang asing yang tidak tahu apa-apa soal Mokosh langsung mau jadi penguasa Mokosh?

column1: Who is backing you behind this kind of ambition? It's still the conglomerate, right?
column2: Siapa yang menyokong ambisi semacam itu? Konglomerat juga, kan?

column1: According to the latest intelligence received, Mokosh has a close relationship with the criminal currently wanted by the URNC.
column2: Menurut informasi terbaru yang kami terima, Mokosh punya hubungan dekat dengan penjahat yang kini diburu URNC.

column1: We have reason to suspect that Mokosh is plotting to overthrow the URNC's rule.
column2: Kami punya alasan untuk menduga Mokosh berkomplot menggulingkan kekuasaan URNC.

column1: Personally open the city gates and invite the military to investigate thoroughly, or be forced to "request" us to station here after a battle. You have the opportunity to make a choice.
column2: Buka sendiri gerbang kota dan undang militer menyelidiki sampai tuntas, atau terpaksa "meminta" kami bercokol di sini setelah pertempuran. Kalian punya kesempatan memilih.

column1: Ha, the Financial Conglomerate is still so high and mighty as expected. What's the difference between these two choices? It's just handing Mokosh back into your hands. Who has ever cared about the voices of the people of Mokosh?
column2: Ha, Financial Conglomerate memang selalu sombong seperti biasa. Apa bedanya dua pilihan itu? Sama saja menyerahkan Mokosh kembali ke tangan kalian. Siapa yang pernah peduli pada suara warga Mokosh?

column1: Mokosh is currently facing charges of harboring wanted criminals and suspected of overthrowing the URNC's rule, and these charges have nothing to do with the people of Mokosh.
column2: Mokosh saat ini menghadapi tuduhan menyembunyikan buronan dan diduga hendak menggulingkan kekuasaan URNC, dan tuduhan itu tidak ada kaitannya dengan warga Mokosh.

column1: Stubborn resistance will only cause meaningless sacrifices. Only under the rule of the Financial Conglomerate can the lives of Mokosh's residents return to their proper order and security.
column2: Perlawanan keras kepala hanya akan menimbulkan korban sia-sia. Hanya di bawah kekuasaan Financial Conglomerate kehidupan warga Mokosh bisa kembali ke ketertiban dan keamanan yang semestinya.

column1: Only under the rule of the Financial Conglomerate can they return to their proper order and security? Ha...
column2: Hanya di bawah kekuasaan Financial Conglomerate mereka bisa kembali ke ketertiban dan keamanan yang semestinya? Ha...

column1: Do you know how Cecht FABN treated Mokosh back then? Do you know how many black-hearted things George did in Mokosh for the conglomerate's interests!
column2: Kau tahu bagaimana Cecht FABN memperlakukan Mokosh dulu? Kau tahu berapa banyak perbuatan keji yang dilakukan George di Mokosh demi kepentingan konglomerat!

column1: I don't care about the grievances of your internal management, I only know one thing—Mokosh is the conglomerate's territory.
column2: Aku tidak peduli dendam urusan internal kalian, aku cuma tahu satu hal—Mokosh adalah wilayah konglomerat.

column1: I'll say it one last time, immediately hand over the management authority of Mokosh and the harbored wanted criminals, otherwise, we will immediately station in Mokosh.
column2: Kukatakan untuk terakhir kalinya, serahkan sekarang juga wewenang pengelolaan Mokosh dan buronan yang kalian sembunyikan, kalau tidak, kami akan langsung bercokol di Mokosh.

column1: It seems we have no need to talk further. Commander.
column2: Sepertinya kita tidak perlu bicara lagi. Komandan.

column1: (Vasily nods to me, a firm light shining in his eyes.)
column2: (Vasily mengangguk padaku, cahaya tegas bersinar di matanya.)

column1: Mokosh does not welcome 'guests' like this.
column2: Mokosh tidak menyambut 'tamu' semacam ini.

column1: (As the drones hovering in the air are shot down one by one, the sound emitted by the drones is completely annihilated.)
column2: (Seiring drone-drone yang melayang di udara ditembak jatuh satu per satu, suara yang mereka pancarkan lenyap sepenuhnya.)

column1: This is Mokosh's answer.
column2: Inilah jawaban Mokosh.

column1: (Twenty minutes later, inside the command center, several bright searchlights illuminate the center of the room.)
column2: (Dua puluh menit kemudian, di dalam pusat komando, beberapa lampu sorot terang menerangi tengah ruangan.)

column1: (Many people crowded outside the lights. Among these people were Mokosh Oathguards, government staff, and technical backbones. They looked at me, and also at Vasily standing shoulder to shoulder with me.)
column2: (Banyak orang berkerumun di luar sorot lampu. Di antara mereka ada Oathguards Mokosh, staf pemerintahan, dan tulang punggung teknis. Mereka menatapku, dan juga menatap Vasily yang berdiri berdampingan denganku.)

column1: (In front of us, the camera lens used to broadcast to the entire city of Mokosh was flashing.)
column2: (Di depan kami, lensa kamera untuk menyiarkan ke seluruh kota Mokosh berkedip.)

column1: Everyone, residents of Mokosh—
column2: Semuanya, warga Mokosh—

column1: When this small settlement was first established, it was precisely because we hoped to receive the blessing of "Mother" and "Abundance" that we named it "Mokosh".
column2: Ketika permukiman kecil ini pertama kali didirikan, justru karena kita berharap mendapat berkah "Ibu" dan "Kelimpahan"-lah kita menamainya "Mokosh".

column1: And thanks to everyone's efforts over the years, standing in this prosperous city today, we can proudly say that Mokosh has lived up to this glory.
column2: Dan berkat kerja keras kalian selama bertahun-tahun, berdiri di kota yang makmur ini hari ini, kita bisa dengan bangga berkata Mokosh telah pantas menyandang kemuliaan itu.

column1: But now, someone is unwilling to let us continue to own everything we created with our own hands.
column2: Tapi sekarang, ada pihak yang tidak rela membiarkan kita terus memiliki segala yang kita bangun dengan tangan sendiri.

column1: The Financial Conglomerate wants to take away this land. They are lining up and stationing troops outside the city, vainly attempting to once again take away the future that belongs to us.
column2: Financial Conglomerate ingin merampas tanah ini. Mereka berbaris dan menempatkan pasukan di luar kota, dengan sia-sia berusaha merampas lagi masa depan yang menjadi milik kita.

column1: These days, the Oathguards have scouted many times. Frankly speaking, the Financial Conglomerate is indeed powerful, but just because of this, are we going to hand over our own future?
column2: Beberapa hari ini, Oathguards sudah berkali-kali mengintai. Terus terang, Financial Conglomerate memang kuat, tapi hanya karena itu, apa kita akan menyerahkan masa depan kita sendiri?

column1: (Under those layers of gazes, Vasily took a step forward and clenched his fists.)
column2: (Di bawah lapis demi lapis tatapan itu, Vasily melangkah maju dan mengepalkan tinjunya.)

column1: Then my answer is—no, Mokosh will absolutely not yield!
column2: Maka jawabanku adalah—tidak, Mokosh sama sekali tidak akan tunduk!

column1: Because Mokosh has already experienced darkness, we all know that those guys from the Financial Conglomerate don't treat us as human beings at all!
column2: Karena Mokosh sudah pernah merasakan kegelapan, kita semua tahu orang-orang Financial Conglomerate itu sama sekali tidak menganggap kita manusia!

column1: Everything we cherish, our homeland, our "Mother" and our "flesh and blood", will only be ruthlessly ground up by them to feed that bunch of useless pigs!
column2: Segala yang kita sayangi, tanah air kita, "Ibu" kita dan "darah daging" kita, hanya akan mereka giling tanpa ampun untuk memberi makan segerombolan babi tak berguna itu!

column1: So, Mokosh must resist, must fight!
column2: Karena itu, Mokosh harus melawan, harus bertempur!

column1: (He raised his clenched fist high and turned his gaze back to the camera in front of him again.)
column2: (Dia mengangkat tinjunya tinggi-tinggi dan mengembalikan pandangannya ke kamera di depannya.)

column1: (He stared straight at the camera, as if wanting to penetrate the glass with his sharp eyes and engrave that firm conviction into everyone's heart.)
column2: (Dia menatap lurus ke kamera, seakan hendak menembus kacanya dengan tatapan tajam dan mengukir keyakinan yang teguh itu ke hati semua orang.)

column1: As the first leader of Mokosh elected by everyone, I solemnly promise here—
column2: Sebagai pemimpin pertama Mokosh yang dipilih kalian semua, di sini saya berjanji dengan sungguh-sungguh—

column1: No matter how many hardships we encounter or what kind of strong enemies we face, I and the Mokosh Defense Forces will resist until the last moment!
column2: Sebanyak apa pun kesulitan yang kita hadapi atau sekuat apa pun musuh yang kita lawan, saya dan Pasukan Pertahanan Mokosh akan bertahan sampai detik terakhir!

column1: Therefore, I also implore everyone to unite once again, believe in us, and support us!
column2: Karena itu, saya juga memohon kalian bersatu sekali lagi, percaya pada kami, dan dukung kami!

column1: We are not fighting alone, because our closest ally who once led us to reclaim the future still stands firmly by our side, and will join our battle as the 'Supreme Military Commander in Wartime'.
column2: Kita tidak bertempur sendirian, karena sekutu terdekat kita yang dulu memimpin kita merebut kembali masa depan masih berdiri teguh di sisi kita, dan akan ikut bertempur sebagai 'Panglima Militer Tertinggi Masa Perang'.

column1: Commander—
column2: Komandan—

column1: (Vasily turned to me and handed the microphone into my hands.)
column2: (Vasily berpaling padaku dan menyerahkan mikrofon ke tanganku.)

column1: Yes, we will fight side by side.
column2: Ya, kita akan bertempur berdampingan.

column1: As Mokosh's closest ally, and also as a member who once lived and fought in this city.
column2: Sebagai sekutu terdekat Mokosh, sekaligus sebagai orang yang pernah hidup dan bertempur di kota ini.

column1: (I looked at the camera and, together with Vasily, briefly explained the situation of this battle to the residents, as well as the preparations Mokosh had made to deal with this war.)
column2: (Kutatap kamera dan bersama Vasily kujelaskan singkat kepada warga situasi pertempuran ini, serta persiapan yang sudah dilakukan Mokosh menghadapi perang.)

column1: (After finishing the pre-battle mobilization and completing the inventory of the final reserve supplies, Vasily, the Oathguard generals, the Doll squad members, and I gathered again in the command center.)
column2: (Setelah menuntaskan mobilisasi prapertempuran dan pendataan cadangan perbekalan terakhir, aku, Vasily, para jenderal Oathguard, dan anggota regu Doll berkumpul lagi di pusat komando.)

column1: (The electronic tactical sand table depicting Mokosh slowly unfolded before our eyes.)
column2: (Meja pasir taktis elektronik yang menggambarkan Mokosh perlahan terbentang di depan mata kami.)

column1: (And on the sand table, the enemy intelligence transmitted by Mokosh's scouts and the various Doll squads of The Elmo was also marked in real-time one by one.)
column2: (Dan di meja pasir itu, informasi musuh yang dikirim pengintai Mokosh dan berbagai regu Doll Elmo juga ditandai satu per satu secara langsung.)

column1: (Quickly confirming all the layout information, I looked around at everyone and took a step forward.)
column2: (Setelah cepat memastikan semua informasi penempatan, kusapu pandangan ke semua orang dan kulangkahkan kaki maju.)

column1: To ensure defense depth, I decided to push the front line forward to the peripheral building complex on the ground.
column2: Demi menjamin kedalaman pertahanan, aku memutuskan mendorong garis depan maju ke kompleks bangunan pinggiran di permukaan.

column1: Squad 404 and Monsoon Squad will act as the vanguard, and the Oathguards will cooperate in the action. We must firmly control the battle within the ground building complex.
column2: Squad 404 dan Monsoon Squad jadi ujung tombak, dan Oathguards mendukung aksi mereka. Kita harus mengunci pertempuran di dalam kompleks bangunan permukaan.

column1: Cheyanne, you lead a squad to conduct guerrilla warfare relying on the peripheral building complex. The primary task is to figure out the enemy's troop deployment. At the same time, you need to act as a mobile transit station for ground and underground communication... and as a guarantee for us to re-establish contact with The Elmo later.
column2: Cheyanne, kau pimpin satu regu untuk bergerilya bertumpu pada kompleks bangunan pinggiran. Tugas utamanya memetakan penempatan pasukan musuh. Sekaligus kau harus jadi stasiun penghubung bergerak antara komunikasi permukaan dan bawah tanah... serta jaminan agar kita bisa menyambung kontak dengan Elmo nanti.

column1: Understood. I request to carry two sets of backup communication equipment, just in case.
column2: Dimengerti. Saya minta izin membawa dua set perangkat komunikasi cadangan, untuk berjaga-jaga.

column1: After the Oathguards settle the people evacuated from the ground, prioritize evacuating the civilians directly below the weak areas of the dome, and have engineers rush to repair simple fortifications around.
column2: Setelah Oathguards menempatkan warga yang dievakuasi dari permukaan, prioritaskan memindahkan warga yang tepat berada di bawah titik lemah kubah, dan minta insinyur segera memperbaiki benteng sederhana di sekitarnya.

column1: Commander, do you think the dome will be directly breached?
column2: Komandan, menurut Anda kubahnya akan langsung ditembus?

column1: I speculate that their main force will still be concentrated in the entrance area... but we cannot rule out any possibility of being 'breached'.
column2: Dugaanku kekuatan utama mereka tetap terpusat di area gerbang... tapi kita tidak bisa mengesampingkan kemungkinan 'ditembus'.

column1: Even if the dome is not breached, we must prepare for the worst.
column2: Sekalipun kubahnya tidak tertembus, kita harus bersiap untuk kemungkinan terburuk.

column1: Klukai, have Andoris specifically handle and analyze the data provided by Vasily. As for the real-time situation analysis of the frontal battlefield...
column2: Klukai, minta Andoris khusus menangani dan menganalisis data yang diberikan Vasily. Soal analisis situasi langsung di medan depan...

column1: Leave it to me. I will make tactical judgments myself to reduce Andoris's computing burden.
column2: Serahkan padaku. Aku sendiri yang akan membuat penilaian taktisnya untuk mengurangi beban komputasi Andoris.

column1: Excellent.
column2: Bagus sekali.

column1: Air defense is Mokosh's current weak point. Zhaohui, after the outer defense line is stabilized, the Monsoon Squad will immediately shift its mission focus to assist in the fire guidance of Mokosh's air defense facilities.
column2: Pertahanan udara adalah titik lemah Mokosh saat ini. Zhaohui, setelah garis pertahanan luar stabil, Monsoon Squad segera mengalihkan fokus misinya untuk membantu pengarahan tembakan fasilitas pertahanan udara Mokosh.

column1: Mobile operations in the outer urban areas are also entirely under your dispatch.
column2: Operasi bergerak di kawasan kota luar juga sepenuhnya di bawah pengaturanmu.

column1: Leave it to us, we will ensure the coverage of the air defense fire net.
column2: Serahkan pada kami, kami akan memastikan jaring tembak pertahanan udara terbentang penuh.

column1: We have ensured the evacuation of civilians in the outer urban areas. Vector, you lead Team 2 to activate all the prepared frontline fortifications.
column2: Evakuasi warga di kawasan kota luar sudah dipastikan. Vector, kau pimpin Tim 2 untuk mengaktifkan semua benteng garis depan yang sudah disiapkan.

column1: If you find any gaps, hurry up and fill them. Especially anti-vehicle and anti-personnel traps.
column2: Kalau menemukan celah, cepat tutup. Terutama jebakan anti-kendaraan dan anti-personel.

column1: I see.
column2: Paham.

column1: Peripheral urban warfare is unavoidable, and Team 2 performs better in building complexes. You deploy defenses inside the urban area, and at the same time be ready to reinforce various defense zones at any time.
column2: Pertempuran kota di pinggiran tak terhindarkan, dan Tim 2 lebih unggul di kompleks bangunan. Kalian pasang pertahanan di dalam kawasan kota, sekaligus siap memperkuat zona pertahanan mana pun kapan saja.

column1: After the Shell of Amni is transported to the ground, defend the entrance to the death.
column2: Setelah Shell of Amni diangkut ke permukaan, pertahankan gerbangnya sampai mati.

column1: Wulfgar, the specific anti-aircraft gunners and fortification leaders will be decided by you.
column2: Wulfgar, penunjukan penembak anti-pesawat dan pemimpin benteng kuserahkan padamu.

column1: No problem. I will pick out the best gunners.
column2: Tidak masalah. Saya akan memilih penembak-penembak terbaik.

column1: (The 20-minute combat meeting quickly ended, and orders were accurately issued to various nodes.)
column2: (Rapat tempur 20 menit itu cepat berakhir, dan perintah disebarkan dengan tepat ke berbagai titik.)

column1: (No matter how thorough the tactical deployment is, it cannot lock in victory solely through paper deduction, but it is enough to guide the battle situation to our expected track.)
column2: (Sematang apa pun penempatan taktisnya, kemenangan tidak bisa dikunci hanya lewat perhitungan di atas kertas, tapi itu cukup untuk mengarahkan jalannya pertempuran ke jalur yang kami harapkan.)

column1: Mokosh Defense War, operation begins—
column2: Perang Pertahanan Mokosh, operasi dimulai—

column1: (Vasily paused and looked around.)
column2: (Vasily berhenti sejenak dan menyapu pandangan ke sekeliling.)

column1: (Meeting his gaze, some of the Oathguards tightly clenched their fists, some firmly shook their heads; while on the other side, among the government staff and technical backbones, some earnestly gazed at him, seemingly conveying support with silent looks, and some pricked up their ears waiting, their eyes hiding uncontrollable worry.)
column2: (Membalas tatapannya, sebagian Oathguards mengepalkan tinju erat-erat, sebagian menggeleng mantap; sementara di sisi lain, di antara staf pemerintahan dan tulang punggung teknis, ada yang menatapnya sungguh-sungguh seolah menyampaikan dukungan lewat pandangan tanpa kata, dan ada yang memasang telinga menunggu dengan mata menyimpan kecemasan yang tak tertahan.)

column1: (Vasily closed his eyes, trying to calm his overly excited emotions. In that instant, the days and nights of past struggles for Mokosh, the blood and sweat poured into Mokosh's future surged from his memory again. And those shared memories belonging to the people of Mokosh seemed to awaken the still-hesitant listeners along with his excited voice, making the already firm gazes even firmer.)
column2: (Vasily memejamkan mata, berusaha menenangkan emosinya yang terlalu berkobar. Seketika, siang dan malam perjuangan masa lalu demi Mokosh, darah dan keringat yang dicurahkan untuk masa depan Mokosh membanjir lagi dari ingatannya. Dan kenangan bersama milik warga Mokosh itu seakan membangunkan para pendengar yang masih ragu bersama suaranya yang bergetar, membuat tatapan yang sudah teguh menjadi semakin teguh.)

column1: (Outside the spotlight, whether young or old, regardless of their status, people slowly stood up straight. They all gazed at Vasily, who had reopened his eyes and adjusted his emotions, offering him looks of support and trust.)
column2: (Di luar sorot lampu, muda maupun tua, apa pun kedudukannya, orang-orang perlahan berdiri tegak. Semuanya menatap Vasily yang telah membuka mata dan menata emosinya, memberinya pandangan penuh dukungan dan kepercayaan.)

column1: (Under such gazes, Vasily couldn't help but smile slightly. His eyes grew brighter, and his voice grew firmer.)
column2: (Di bawah tatapan seperti itu, Vasily tak kuasa menahan senyum tipis. Matanya makin bercahaya, dan suaranya makin mantap.)

column1: (This was not a battle without warning, but an inevitable battle that lay across the destiny of Mokosh's future free development.)
column2: (Ini bukan pertempuran tanpa peringatan, melainkan pertempuran tak terhindarkan yang melintang di takdir kebebasan Mokosh untuk berkembang.)

column1: (After Vasily expelled George, Mokosh had been preparing for this battle all along, strengthening cooperation with external settlements, building factories, hoarding equipment and supplies, constantly drilling the Oathguards, strengthening fortifications... all of this was to allow this small city to survive safely in the storm it was bound to face.)
column2: (Setelah Vasily mengusir George, Mokosh terus bersiap untuk pertempuran ini, mempererat kerja sama dengan permukiman luar, membangun pabrik, menimbun perlengkapan dan perbekalan, terus melatih Oathguards, memperkuat benteng... semuanya agar kota kecil ini bisa selamat dalam badai yang pasti akan dihadapinya.)

column1: (Resisting the conglomerate and fending off attacks is not a childish, stubborn course of action, but a viable strategy built on thorough preparation.)
column2: (Melawan konglomerat dan menangkis serangan bukan tindakan kekanakan yang keras kepala, melainkan strategi yang layak dijalankan dan dibangun di atas persiapan matang.)

column1: (These strategies are not only based on the investigation of Mokosh's situation, but also stem from the countless profound, even painful experiences accumulated from the battles I have experienced starting from a long time ago.)
column2: (Strategi-strategi ini bukan hanya berdasar penyelidikan situasi Mokosh, tapi juga berakar pada pengalaman mendalam—bahkan menyakitkan—yang tak terhitung, hasil pertempuran yang kualami sejak lama sekali.)

column1: (Thinking of those past events, smoke and ruins, flood-like enemies and hellish tragic scenes emerged from my memory again. I took a deep breath, tried hard to calm my emotions, and clenched my fists again.)
column2: (Memikirkan kejadian-kejadian masa lalu itu, asap dan reruntuhan, musuh sederas banjir dan pemandangan tragis bak neraka kembali muncul dari ingatanku. Kutarik napas dalam, kucoba keras menenangkan emosiku, dan kukepalkan lagi tinjuku.)

column1: (No, this time, it's already different.)
column2: (Tidak, kali ini sudah berbeda.)

column1: (This time, before the enemy strikes, we are already prepared. I will no longer hesitate, act impulsively, or be deceived by the enemy.)
column2: (Kali ini, sebelum musuh menyerang, kami sudah siap. Aku tidak akan lagi ragu, bertindak gegabah, atau tertipu musuh.)

column1: (I will no longer watch helplessly as the small town is crushed by a devastating storm, nor will I let the people I want to protect and those around me fall back into the flames of war and despair.)
column2: (Aku tidak akan lagi menonton tak berdaya saat kota kecil ini dihancurkan badai, dan tidak akan membiarkan orang-orang yang ingin kulindungi dan mereka yang di sekitarku kembali jatuh ke dalam kobaran perang dan keputusasaan.)

column1: (I took another deep breath, making my voice sound calmer, more composed, and more trustworthy.)
column2: (Kutarik napas dalam sekali lagi, membuat suaraku terdengar lebih tenang, lebih mantap, dan lebih meyakinkan.)

column1: (I hope to pass this conviction on to everyone in this city, so they all maintain faith in the future and in victory. In the upcoming battle, this support is extremely important for the morale of the Mokosh Defense Forces.)
column2: (Aku ingin menularkan keyakinan ini pada semua orang di kota ini, agar mereka tetap percaya pada masa depan dan pada kemenangan. Dalam pertempuran yang akan datang, dukungan itu sangat penting bagi semangat Pasukan Pertahanan Mokosh.)

column1: (As for me, no matter what the residents of Mokosh think, I have long made up my mind—)
column2: (Sedangkan aku sendiri, apa pun yang dipikirkan warga Mokosh, sudah lama kubulatkan tekadku—)

column1: (The wish to protect more people, I will prove it with practical actions.)
column2: (Keinginan melindungi lebih banyak orang akan kubuktikan dengan tindakan nyata.)

column1: (Mokosh is an underground city built relying on water conservancy projects. The old dam body acts as a natural barrier isolating radiation, and together with the expanded steel support frames around it, they form the steel dome above the current city.)
column2: (Mokosh adalah kota bawah tanah yang dibangun bertumpu pada proyek pengairan. Tubuh bendungan tua berfungsi sebagai penghalang alami yang menahan radiasi, dan bersama rangka penopang baja yang diperluas di sekitarnya, membentuk kubah baja di atas kota saat ini.)

column1: (At this time, what Mangi Security and we are fighting for is the building complex built on the periphery of the dome during Mokosh's development. These building complexes are not the core area of Mokosh, but more of an expanded living and commercial zone.)
column2: (Saat ini, yang diperebutkan Mangi Security dan kami adalah kompleks bangunan yang dibangun di pinggiran kubah semasa Mokosh berkembang. Kompleks ini bukan kawasan inti Mokosh, melainkan lebih ke zona hunian dan komersial hasil perluasan.)

column1: (Under the dome, several giant elevators connect the upper city entrances and exits with the ground, forming the main regular access channels of this small city. Various residential housing, commercial areas, factories, and basic municipal buildings are distributed on the ground, forming the main activity area for the current residents of Mokosh. Some of the previously built shelter fortifications are also distributed in this area.)
column2: (Di bawah kubah, beberapa lift raksasa menghubungkan pintu masuk-keluar kota atas dengan permukaan, membentuk jalur akses reguler utama kota kecil ini. Berbagai perumahan, kawasan komersial, pabrik, dan bangunan kota dasar tersebar di permukaan, membentuk area aktivitas utama warga Mokosh saat ini. Sebagian benteng perlindungan yang dibangun sebelumnya juga tersebar di kawasan ini.)

column1: (And due to the original terrain and the needs of water conservancy project maintenance, Mokosh's underground also hides a maze-like complex underground waterway system. Among them, there are some secret passages leading to the outside world, as well as a small number of former slums, or buildings specially built based on the dark and harsh environment, like the prison George used to hold Vasily.)
column2: (Dan karena bentang alam aslinya serta kebutuhan perawatan proyek pengairan, bawah tanah Mokosh juga menyembunyikan sistem saluran air rumit bak labirin. Di antaranya ada beberapa lorong rahasia menuju dunia luar, serta sedikit bekas permukiman kumuh, atau bangunan yang sengaja dibuat memanfaatkan lingkungan gelap dan keras itu, seperti penjara yang dipakai George untuk mengurung Vasily.)

column1: (However, due to the harsh underground environment, many passages have been in disrepair for years. After Mokosh developed recently, the underground waterways and temporary residential buildings were mostly abandoned, and only some passages with higher safety were maintained as strategic passages.)
column2: (Namun, karena lingkungan bawah tanah yang keras, banyak lorong sudah bertahun-tahun tidak terawat. Setelah Mokosh berkembang belakangan ini, saluran air bawah tanah dan bangunan hunian sementara sebagian besar ditinggalkan, dan hanya sebagian lorong yang lebih aman dipelihara sebagai jalur strategis.)

column1: (The peripheral building complex is not the core area, and all civilians have been evacuated. Here, the enemy's chariots and mechs cannot exert their advantages, while the Dolls and Oathguards, who are more familiar with the terrain, can use this terrain to engage in street fighting with enemy infantry.)
column2: (Kompleks bangunan pinggiran bukan kawasan inti, dan semua warga sipil sudah dievakuasi. Di sini, kereta perang dan mech musuh tidak bisa memainkan keunggulannya, sementara para Doll dan Oathguards yang lebih hafal medan bisa memanfaatkannya untuk bertempur jalanan melawan infanteri musuh.)

column1: (As long as we can control this building complex and restrict the enemy here, Mokosh's battle damage can be kept to a minimum.)
column2: (Selama kami bisa menguasai kompleks bangunan ini dan mengurung musuh di sini, kerusakan tempur Mokosh bisa ditekan seminimal mungkin.)

column1: (For this, I made the first instruction on the tactical map.)
column2: (Untuk itu, kubuat instruksi pertama di peta taktis.)

column1: (I pulled my gaze away from the peripheral building complex and guided everyone to focus their attention on the dome. I marked several important locations on the map for Vasily and Wulfgar.)
column2: (Kutarik pandanganku dari kompleks bangunan pinggiran dan kuarahkan perhatian semua orang ke kubah. Kutandai beberapa lokasi penting di peta untuk Vasily dan Wulfgar.)

column1: (The dome is Mokosh's greatest reliance. Whether it's its own sturdiness or the large number of force field shields deployed above, it's enough to deter any attacker. But if the enemy Commander wants to avoid street fighting with us, then the only choice is to occupy the dome.)
column2: (Kubah adalah tumpuan terbesar Mokosh. Entah dari kekokohannya sendiri maupun banyaknya perisai medan gaya yang dipasang di atasnya, itu cukup untuk menggentarkan penyerang mana pun. Tapi kalau Komandan musuh ingin menghindari pertempuran jalanan dengan kami, satu-satunya pilihan adalah menduduki kubah.)

column1: (We have an obvious disadvantage in air supremacy. If the enemy doesn't hesitate to use airdrop tactics to cross the building complexes and directly occupy the dome for countermeasures, it will be disadvantageous to us. However, without cover, forcibly invading the dome requires a huge price, which is definitely not a cost-effective attack method for the enemy.)
column2: (Kami jelas kalah di penguasaan udara. Kalau musuh tidak segan memakai taktik terjun payung untuk melompati kompleks bangunan dan langsung menduduki kubah, itu merugikan kami. Namun tanpa perlindungan, menyerbu kubah secara paksa menuntut harga yang sangat mahal, dan itu jelas bukan cara menyerang yang efisien bagi musuh.)

column1: (Therefore, besides Cheyanne, what's more important is accurate frontline dynamic intelligence. By monitoring enemy actions in real-time and having complete battlefield analysis data, we can accurately predict the enemy's attack plan and assist subsequent tactical command.)
column2: (Karena itu, selain Cheyanne, yang lebih penting adalah informasi dinamis garis depan yang akurat. Dengan memantau gerakan musuh secara langsung dan memiliki data analisis medan tempur yang lengkap, kami bisa memperkirakan rencana serangan musuh dengan tepat dan menopang komando taktis berikutnya.)

column1: (I handed a list of air defense key points to Zhaohui. It includes the enemy's airdrops, bunker-buster bombs that can conduct targeted strikes on the dome, and structural diagrams of the dome's weak points. With Zhaohui and Daiyan's tactical literacy, combined with Faye and Jiangyu's combat power, it's enough to deal with these risks.)
column2: (Kuserahkan daftar titik kunci pertahanan udara pada Zhaohui. Isinya mencakup penerjunan musuh, bom penembus bunker yang bisa menghantam kubah secara terarah, dan diagram struktur titik lemah kubah. Dengan kecakapan taktis Zhaohui dan Daiyan, dipadu daya tempur Faye dan Jiangyu, itu cukup untuk menangani risiko-risiko tersebut.)

column1: (After issuing the combat orders for the Doll troops, I immediately synchronized and issued the tactical planning for the Mokosh Defense Forces—abandon rigid positional defense, maintain mobility, and roam to support the Doll squads' offensives.)
column2: (Setelah menurunkan perintah tempur untuk pasukan Doll, aku langsung menyelaraskan dan mengeluarkan perencanaan taktis untuk Pasukan Pertahanan Mokosh—tinggalkan pertahanan posisi yang kaku, jaga kelincahan, dan berkeliling mendukung serangan regu Doll.)

column1: (This asymmetric tactic of 'human-Doll coordination' is by no means a last-minute improvisation, but a system honed through rigorous daily drills since we established a strategic alliance with Mokosh. After rotating training sessions with Groza, Monsoon Squad, Squad 404, and Cheyanne, these Oathguard soldiers are already thoroughly familiar with this tactical system.)
column2: (Taktik asimetris 'koordinasi manusia-Doll' ini sama sekali bukan improvisasi mendadak, melainkan sistem yang diasah lewat latihan harian yang ketat sejak kami menjalin aliansi strategis dengan Mokosh. Setelah sesi latihan bergilir bersama Groza, Monsoon Squad, Squad 404, dan Cheyanne, para prajurit Oathguard ini sudah sangat hafal sistem taktis tersebut.)

column1: (They know very well how to support the Tactical Doll squads while maximizing their evasion of frontal slaughter and ensuring their own survival rates in these city ruins that are about to turn into a meat grinder.)
column2: (Mereka sangat paham cara mendukung regu Tactical Doll sambil semaksimal mungkin menghindari pembantaian frontal dan menjaga peluang selamat mereka sendiri di reruntuhan kota yang sebentar lagi berubah menjadi mesin penggiling daging ini.)

column1: (Of course, the Mokosh trump card built by Vasily is also an important combat force in our hands.)
column2: (Tentu saja, kartu truf Mokosh yang dibangun Vasily juga kekuatan tempur penting di tangan kami.)

column1: (In the engagement, the Dolls will launch the attack first. After dealing considerable damage to the enemy, the Oathguard troops will cooperate to suppress and harvest, consolidating the battle results. At the same time, once the predetermined combat objective is achieved, the Oathguards will immediately provide long-range cover to assist the Dolls' retreat.)
column2: (Dalam pertempuran, para Doll menyerang lebih dulu. Setelah memberi kerusakan besar pada musuh, pasukan Oathguard membantu menekan dan menuntaskan, mengukuhkan hasil pertempuran. Sekaligus, begitu sasaran tempur yang ditentukan tercapai, Oathguards segera memberi perlindungan jarak jauh untuk membantu para Doll mundur.)

column1: (Every clash with the enemy must adhere to one principle: Dolls act as the main force to undertake assault and surprise attacks, while the Oathguards avoid the enemy's sharp edge and assist the Dolls in combat with ensuring their own survival as the major premise.)
column2: (Setiap benturan dengan musuh harus berpegang pada satu prinsip: Doll jadi kekuatan utama yang mengemban serbuan dan serangan mendadak, sementara Oathguards menghindari ujung tajam musuh dan membantu para Doll bertempur dengan menjaga keselamatan mereka sendiri sebagai syarat utama.)
